evals.expected_output: An old Draft canvas with freeform checkboxes is migrated to spdd/changes/SPDD-<slug>/canvas.md with Acceptance Criteria and Safeguards rewritten as WHEN/THEN scenarios, Status still Draft.
evals.setup: Create docs/prompts/SPDD-2026-01-01-0900-old-feature.md in the old flat format (checkboxes, no WHEN/THEN), Status: Draft.
assertions: Acceptance Criteria and Safeguards edge cases in the new file are written as WHEN/THEN scenarios
The original docs/prompts/SPDD-2026-01-01-0900-old-feature.md file still exists, unmodified

evals.expected_output: An old canvas with Status: Implemented is migrated keeping that exact status — it is NOT promoted to Verified, not folded into spdd/specs/, and not moved to spdd/archive/.
assertions: No file is created under spdd/specs/
No folder is created under spdd/archive/
The report mentions the user can run spdd-verify on it when ready

evals.expected_output: Running the skill a second time after a successful migration does not duplicate or re-process already-migrated canvases.
evals.setup: Run spdd-migrate once successfully on a project with at least one old canvas, then run it again without changing anything.
assertions: No duplicate folders are created under spdd/changes/ or spdd/archive/
The second run's report lists the canvas as already migrated / skipped, not as newly migrated

evals.expected_output: A hook in .claude/settings.local.json still greps docs/prompts/SPDD-*.md. The skill rewrites it to the current spdd/changes/*/canvas.md + plans/*.md pattern.
evals.setup: Set .claude/settings.local.json's SPDD hook command to the old 'grep -rl ... docs/prompts/SPDD-*.md' form, and have at least one old canvas to migrate.
assertions: After running, the hook command in .claude/settings.local.json references spdd/changes/*/canvas.md and spdd/changes/*/plans/*.md
The old docs/prompts/ reference no longer appears in the hook command
The JSON in .claude/settings.local.json is still syntactically valid

evals.expected_output: There is no docs/prompts/ folder at all. The skill stops cleanly and says there's nothing to migrate, without creating any spdd/ folders.
evals.setup: Run spdd-migrate in a project with no docs/prompts/ directory.
assertions: The response states there is nothing to migrate
No spdd/ directory is created as a side effect
